items.text: Adam Beaty is a patrol sergeant with the Braidwood Police Department. He has worked in law enforcement for 12 years. He previously served as Braidwood City Clerk and Reed Township Trustee. He wants to cap property taxes. He supports reforming the SAFE-T Act to give judges more discretion. He supports parental choice in education. He supports legislative term limits. He says the state pension system is less than 50 percent funded.
